resources.string: NoLockQS
Keeps Quick Settings and the power menu locked.
Version %1$s
Module active
Quick Settings and the power menu are blocked whenever your phone is locked.
Quick Settings is blocked whenever your phone is locked.
The power menu is blocked whenever your phone is locked.
Protection off
Nothing is blocked while your phone is locked. Tap a box below to turn a protection back on.
Module inactive
Enable NoLockQS in Vector for System UI and System Framework, then reboot.
While your phone is locked
Tap a box to turn it on or off.
On
Off
Enable NoLockQS in Vector to change this, then reopen the app.
Quick Settings
Swipes from the status bar are blocked, so toggles like Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and airplane mode stay out of reach.
Power menu
Holding the power button can\'t open it. Needs System Framework in Vector\'s scope.
